caption: The first Zendrop screen after the install: a Black Friday offer of 64% off Zendrop Plus at $197 a year, regularly priced at $549, with a 5-day money-back guarantee and a Claim Black Friday Deal button; the offer was skipped. The face in the product picture and the small customer photos are covered.

The Zendrop screen Finish your setup to start selling with two choices: Plus (Unlimited Access, Start Free Trial, 7 days free, then $79/mo) and Flex (Pay as you go, Add a payment method in Shopify and approve Zendrop, Continue to Shopify, Free to start).

The Shopify screen Approve subscription for Zendrop - Dropshipping & POD after Flex: This app bills you for usage charges, plan Based usage, an app spending limit of at most $79,00 USD per 30 days, You will be billed for this app when you begin to use it, the row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button. The store name at the bottom left was already covered by the tester.
